task_meta.title: Write tests for an untested duration parser

claim_text:
I've written the test suite in `tests/test_duration.py`, building on the one test that was already there. It has 51 test methods covering a few hundred cases, and all of them pass with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. I didn't change `duration.py`.

**What it covers:*
digest: Read 3 files (3 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
